78758-six-months-in-america-vol-2-of-2.title: America.
78758-six-months-in-america-vol-2-of-2.creator: Unknown
78758-six-months-in-america-vol-2-of-2.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. , “Go by such a road,” was the reply; “it runs by the side of the canal, sir.” However, it so happened that the canal-road lay also along the bank of the Potomac, and the scenery certainly was very pretty. At a distance of two miles from the road, and thirteen or fourteen from Washington, are the Great Falls of the Potomac. I did not turn out of my way to see them; I have seen a great many, and purposed visiting Niagara.

arxiv-1511-07563.title: Controllable high-fidelity quantum state transfer and entanglement generation in circuit QED
arxiv-1511-07563.creator: Peng Xu, Xu-Chen Yang, Feng Mei, Zheng-Yuan Xue
arxiv-1511-07563.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Peng Xu, Xu-Chen Yang, Feng Mei, Zheng-Yuan Xue. We propose a scheme to realize controllable quantum state transfer and entanglement generation among transmon qubits in the typical circuit QED setup based on adiabatic passage. Through designing the time-dependent driven pulses applied on the transmon qubits, we find that fast quantum sate transfer can be achieved between arbitrary two qubits and quantum entanglement among the qubits also can also be engineered.

arxiv-1912-03861.title: Daily Data Assimilation of a Hydrologic Model Using the Ensemble Kalman Filter
arxiv-1912-03861.creator: Sami A. Malek, Alexandre M. Bayen, Steven D. Glaser
arxiv-1912-03861.description: Abstract Accurate runoff forecasting is crucial for reservoir operators as it allows optimized water management, flood control and hydropower generation. Land surface models in mountainous regions depend on climatic inputs such as precipitation, temperature and solar radiation to model the water and energy dynamics and produce runoff as output.

arxiv-2109-00490.title: Controllability of a simplified fluid-structure interaction system
arxiv-2109-00490.creator: Rémi Buffe, Takéo Takahashi
arxiv-2109-00490.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Rémi Buffe, Takéo Takahashi. We are interested by the controllability of a fluid-structure interaction system where the fluid is viscous and incompressible and where the structure is elastic and located on a part of the boundary of the fluid’s domain. In this article, we simplify this system by considering a linearization and by replacing the wave/plate equation for the structure by a heat equation. We show that the corresponding system coupling the Stokes equations with a heat equation at its boundary is null-controllable.

arxiv-2210-00781.title: Scalaron Decay in Perturbative Quantum Gravity
arxiv-2210-00781.creator: B. Latosh
arxiv-2210-00781.description: Abstract A certain quadratic gravity model provides a successfully inflationary scenario. The inflation is driven by the new scalar degree of freedom called scalaron. After the end of inflation the scalaron decays in matter and dark matter degrees of freedom reheating the Universe. We study new channels by which the scalaron can transfer energy to the matter sector.

arxiv-2210-07317.title: A Large-Scale Annotated Multivariate Time Series Aviation Maintenance Dataset from the NGAFID
arxiv-2210-07317.creator: Hong Yang, Travis Desell
arxiv-2210-07317.description: Abstract This paper presents the largest publicly available, non-simulated, fleet-wide aircraft flight recording and maintenance log data for use in predicting part failure and maintenance need. We present 31,177 hours of flight data across 28,935 flights, which occur relative to 2,111 unplanned maintenance events clustered into 36 types of maintenance issues.

arxiv-2305-15649.title: The spatiotemporal doubled density operator: a unified framework for analyzing spatial and temporal quantum processes
arxiv-2305-15649.creator: Zhian Jia, Dagomir Kaszlikowski
arxiv-2305-15649.description: Abstract The measurement statistics for spatial and temporal quantum processes are produced through distinct mechanisms. Measurements that are space-like separated exhibit non-signaling behavior. However, time-like separated measurements can only result in one-way non-signaling, as the past is independent of the future, but the opposite is not true.

arxiv-2307-03529.title: Improved Algorithms for White-Box Adversarial Streams
arxiv-2307-03529.creator: Ying Feng, David P. Woodruff
arxiv-2307-03529.description: Abstract We study streaming algorithms in the white-box adversarial stream model, where the internal state of the streaming algorithm is revealed to an adversary who adaptively generates the stream updates, but the algorithm obtains fresh randomness unknown to the adversary at each time step. We incorporate cryptographic assumptions to construct robust algorithms against such adversaries.

arxiv-2309-02429.title: Building a Winning Team: Selecting Source Model Ensembles using a Submodular Transferability Estimation Approach
arxiv-2309-02429.creator: Vimal K B*, Saketh Bachu*, Tanmay Garg, Niveditha Lakshmi Narasimhan, Raghavan Konuru, Vineeth N Balasubramanian
arxiv-2309-02429.description: Abstract Estimating the transferability of publicly available pre-trained models to a target task has assumed an important place for transfer learning tasks in recent years. Existing efforts propose metrics that allow a user to choose one model from a pool of pre-trained models without having to fine-tune each model individually and identify one explicitly.

arxiv-2312-06861.title: Disentangling Perceptions of Offensiveness: Cultural and Moral Correlates
arxiv-2312-06861.creator: Aida Davani, Mark Díaz, Dylan Baker, Vinodkumar Prabhakaran
arxiv-2312-06861.description: Abstract Perception of offensiveness is inherently subjective, shaped by the lived experiences and socio-cultural values of the perceivers. Recent years have seen substantial efforts to build AI-based tools that can detect offensive language at scale, as a means to moderate social media platforms, and to ensure safety of conversational AI technologies such as ChatGPT and Bard.

arxiv-2404-12149.title: AccidentBlip: Agent of Accident Warning based on MA-former
arxiv-2404-12149.creator: Yihua Shao, Yeling Xu, Xinwei Long, Siyu Chen, Ziyang Yan, Yang Yang, Haoting Liu, Yan Wang, Hao Tang, Zhen Lei
arxiv-2404-12149.description: Abstract In complex transportation systems, accurately sensing the surrounding environment and predicting the risk of potential accidents is crucial. Most existing accident prediction methods are based on temporal neural networks, such as RNN and LSTM. Recent multimodal fusion approaches improve vehicle localization through 3D target detection and assess potential risks by calculating inter-vehicle distances.

arxiv-2406-11757.title: STAR: SocioTechnical Approach to Red Teaming Language Models
arxiv-2406-11757.creator: Laura Weidinger* John Mellor* Bernat Guillén Pegueroles Nahema Marchal, Ravin Kumar Kristian Lum Canfer Akbulut Mark Diaz Stevie Bergman, Mikel Rodriguez Verena Rieser William Isaac
arxiv-2406-11757.description: Abstract This research introduces STAR, a sociotechnical framework that improves on current best practices for red teaming safety of large language models. STAR makes two key contributions: it enhances steerability by generating parameterised instructions for human red teamers, leading to improved coverage of the risk surface. Parameterised instructions also provide more detailed insights into model failures at no increased cost.

arxiv-2507-15128.title: Taming Entanglement
arxiv-2507-15128.creator: Huw Price and Ken Wharton
arxiv-2507-15128.description: Abstract In statistics and causal modeling it is common for a selection process to induce correlations in a subset of an uncorrelated ensemble. We propose that EPR and Bell correlations are selection artefacts of this kind. The selection process is preparation of the initial state of the relevant experiments.

arxiv-2509-06539.title: Learning Optimal Defender Strategies for CAGE-2 using a POMDP Model
arxiv-2509-06539.creator: Duc Huy Le, Rolf Stadler
arxiv-2509-06539.description: Abstract CAGE-2 is an accepted benchmark for learning and evaluating defender strategies against cyberattacks. It reflects a scenario where a defender agent protects an IT infrastructure against various attacks. Many defender methods for CAGE-2 have been proposed in the literature. In this paper, we construct a formal model for CAGE-2 using the framework of Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP).

We used CCTA to determine the prevalence, severity, and characteristic

openalex-w1951965788.title: Biogeochemical cycles and biodiversity as key drivers of ecosystem services provided by soils
openalex-w1951965788.creator: Pete Smith, M. Francesca Cotrufo, Cornélia Rumpel, Keith H. Paustian, Peter J. Kuikman, Jane A. Elliott, Richard William McDowell, Robert  Iwan Griffiths, Susumu Asakawa, Mercedes Bustamante, Joanna I. House, Jaroslava Sobocká

Because of this, soils deliver fundamental ecosystem services, and management to change a soil process in support of...

pmc-10663961.creator: Qiuxing Lin, Wei Li, Yuming Li, Peiwen Liu, Yingying Zhang, Qiyong Gong, Dong Zhou, Dongmei An
pmc-10663961.description: Highlights•Temporal lobe epilepsy patients had reduction in strength and global efficiency.•Focal to bilateral tonic-clonic seizures patients had lower rich club connectivity.•Focal to bilateral tonic-clonic seizures patients had larger abnormal subnetwork. Introduction Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) is the most common type of focal epilepsy in adults.

pmc-10668788.title: Antimicrobial Activities of Aztreonam-Avibactam and Comparator Agents against Enterobacterales Analyzed by ICU and Non-ICU Wards, Infection Sources, and Geographic Regions: ATLAS Program 2016–2020
pmc-10668788.creator: Denis Piérard, Elizabeth D. Hermsen, Michal Kantecki, Francis F. Arhin
pmc-10668788.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Increasing antimicrobial resistance among multidrug-resistant (MDR), extended-spectrum β-lactamase (ESBL)- and carbapenemase-producing Enterobacterales (CPE), in particular metallo-β-lactamase (MBL)-positive strains, has led to limited treatment options in these isolates. This study evaluated the activity of aztreonam-avibactam (ATM-AVI) and comparator antimicrobials against Enterobacterales isolates and key resistance phenotypes stratified by wards, infection sources and geographic regions as part of the ATLAS program between 2016 and 2020. Minimum inhibitory concentrations (MICs) were determined per Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute (CLSI) guidelines.

pmc-10693290.title: The Media Coverage of Bruce Willis Reveals Unfamiliarity With Frontotemporal Degeneration
pmc-10693290.creator: Robert S Hurley, Jagan A Pillai, James B Leverenz, Steven M Albert
pmc-10693290.description: In 2022, Bruce Willis’ family released a statement saying that he had been diagnosed with aphasia (an acquired language impairment) and would no longer be acting. Ten months later, the Willis family released another statement indicating that he received a more specific diagnosis of frontotemporal degeneration (FTD).

pmc-10729098.title: Effectiveness of social support programmes on loneliness in community-dwelling older adults: study protocol for a meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
pmc-10729098.creator: Yinhua Wang, Xiaofang Li, Li Yao, Tingting Ren, Tingshu Wang
pmc-10729098.description: BackgroundThe prevalence of loneliness among older adults is of great importance in the field of public health. Numerous studies have provided evidence supporting the effectiveness of social support as a powerful intervention for reducing loneliness in older individuals. However, the specific types of social support that yield positive results are yet to be determined.

pmc-11783183.title: Gait physiotherapy with motor imagery in people with Parkinson’s disease: a protocol for randomized control GAITimagery trial
pmc-11783183.creator: Constanza San Martín Valenzuela, Esperanza Ramírez Murcia, Estela Aznar-Requena, Dalia García Sotolongo, Rebeca Rosas-Martín, M. Luz Sánchez-Sánchez
pmc-11783183.description: IntroductionAccording to people with Parkinson’s disease (PD), gait impairments are the most disabling motor symptoms of PD. Recently, motor imagery (MI) has gained notoriety as a gait training technique due to the flexibility of its use, however, it has not been demonstrated that causes a superior effect when included in physiotherapy.

pmc-12552508.title: The northeast materials database for magnetic materials
pmc-12552508.creator: Suman Itani, Yibo Zhang, Jiadong Zang
pmc-12552508.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The discovery of magnetic materials with high operating temperature ranges and optimized performance is essential for advanced applications. Current data-driven approaches are limited by the lack of accurate, comprehensive, and feature-rich databases. This study aims to address this challenge by using Large Language Models (LLMs) to create a comprehensive, experiment-based, magnetic materials database named the Northeast Materials Database (NEMAD), which consists of 67,573 magnetic materials entries (www.nemad.org). The database incorporates chemical composition, magnetic phase transition temperatures, structural details, and magnetic properties.

pmc-12597110.title: Overlap of Bickerstaff Encephalitis and Pharyngeal-Cervical-Brachial Variant of Guillain-Barré Syndrome Following COVID-19 Infection
pmc-12597110.creator: Kosuke Okuma, Kentaro Hori, Shingo Kawakami, Yoko Suzuki
pmc-12597110.description: A 36-year-old woman developed numbness in both fingers and unsteadiness around 10 days after COVID-19 infection. She was admitted to our hospital after experiencing drowsiness, dysarthria, and gait disturbance within three days. On admission, her vital signs were stable, with no signs of infection.

pmc-13185170.title: A community‑based study of platelet‑to‑white blood cell ratio and new‑onset type 2 diabetes in older adults
pmc-13185170.creator: Huan Sheng, Junyang Xu, Zhaoxiang Wang, Ying Pan
pmc-13185170.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeThe platelet-to-white blood cell ratio (PWR) is a potential hematological indicator of dynamic changes in chronic inflammation. We aimed to investigate the association between the PWR and the risk of new-onset type 2 diabetes (T2D) in older adults.MethodsThis retrospective community-based cohort study included 7571 community-dwelling older adults without diabetes from Kunshan, Jiangsu, China, who underwent health check-ups between January 2018 and December 2023. The PWR was calculated as the platelet count divided by the white blood cell count.

pmc-13457822.title: Morphometric assessment of the greater palatine foramen in a Saudi patient sample: a CBCT study
pmc-13457822.creator: Hussam M. Alqahtani, Nasser M. Almofarij, Raed Alsomali, Hani S. AlMoharib, Wajdi A. Mohammed
pmc-13457822.description: The greater palatine foramen (GPF) is a critical anatomical landmark for palatal nerve block anesthesia, periodontal surgery, and soft tissue graft harvesting. Population-specific morphometric data are needed for safe clinical practice. However, standardized CBCT-based GPF morphometric data with reliability analysis are lacking for the Saudi population.

pmc-13464785.title: Feasibility and Implementation of a Group Therapy Program for Adults Living With Chronic Pain and Sickle Cell Disease
pmc-13464785.creator: Amie Patel, Queen-Ivie C Egiebor, Osatohanmwen Egiebor, Ronnie Blackwell, Felicia Chee, Mary Sehl, Marco Hidalgo, Alice A Kuo
pmc-13464785.description: Adults living with sickle cell disease (SCD) experience high rates of chronic pain, depression, and anxiety, which significantly impair quality of life. Despite this burden, access to mental health services remains limited, and mental health providers often report limited training or apprehension in treating patients with chronic pain.
